title: AdTech Consultant
excerpt: Architected the Microtask API on Node.js, AWS Lambda, and Elastic Beanstalk for a blockchain rewards platform; launched to 100K+ users in its first quarter.
html:
Contract engagement with a blockchain-based mobile microtask and rewards platform.

Architected the Microtask API on Node.js, AWS Lambda, and Elastic Beanstalk, then launched the service to 100,000+ users with month-over-month growth above 10 percent in its first quarter.
